replace: // a surface change spends no Configuration generation
killedBy: the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a surface change during the load builds nothing into the pane it closed
why: Issue #1015. A surface change that finds the Configuration pane open stops spending the load's generation. `setState`'s close-all hides the pane with a bare class add and never runs `showDevConfig(false)`, so a match starting under the pane while its modules load would have the body built into a pane that is gone.
